spans.s: पौषः [pauṣḥ], N. of a lunar month in which the moon is in the Puṣya asterism (corresponding to DecemberJanuary). -षी The day of full-moon in the month of Pauṣa; पौष्यां तिथौ पुष्यमसूत पत्नी
. -षम् A festival.
A fight, combat.
पौषधः [pauṣadhḥ], A fasting day.
पौष्कर [pauṣkara] रक [raka], रक (-री, -की f.) Relating to the blue lotus.
पौष्करिणी [pauṣkariṇī], A lotus pool or pond.
पौष्कलः [pauṣkalḥ], A species of grain.
पौष्कलावतः [pauṣkalāvatḥ], N. of a friend of Suśruta who asked questions to Dhanvantari for acquiring knowledge.
पौष्कल्यम् [pauṣkalyam], 1 Maturity, complete development, full growth.
Abundance.
पौष्टिक [pauṣṭika], a. (-की f.)
Promoting growth or welfare; मन्त्रवर्जं न दुष्यन्ति कुर्वाणाः पौष्टिकीः क्रियाः
Nourishing, nutritive, nutritious, invigorating.
Preservative. -कम् A cloth worn during the tonsure ceremony.
पौष्णम् [pauṣṇam], The lunar mansion called Revatī.
पौष्प [pauṣpa], a. (-ष्पी f.) [पुष्प्-अण्] Relating to or coming from flowers, floral, flowery; धनुः पौष्पं मौर्वी मधुकरमयी पञ्च विशिखाः Ā. L.
ष्पी N. of the town पाटलिपुत्र q. v.
A kind of spirituous liquor (made from flowers).
पौष्पकम् [pauṣpakam], Green vitriol; oxide of brass (Mar. जस्ताचें फूल).
